Title: Paul Hollywood's chocolate fudge cake
Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients:
- 175g soft margarine, plus extra to grease
- 225g light soft brown sugar
- 200g caster sugar
- 3 large free-range eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 250g plain flour
- 125g cocoa powder
- 1½ tsp baking powder
- ½ tsp fine salt
- 375ml soured cream
